code_changes.change: Closed review created at/after the earliest persisted versioned review audit and lacking any linked audit is now classified as a current missing-audit defect, even when legacy schema has no resolved_at.
Added current-boundary detection and strict unverified legacy action rejection tests.
Added tied timestamp pagination, multi-source/source filter, observation/review multiplicity, merged-master exclusion and CSV/XLSX row tests.

existing_corrections_verified: Exact MergeAudit pair links are respected for merged decisions.
Lifecycle supersession events are excluded from human action enum validation.
Current opportunity list uses a Master ID tie-breaker and no multiplying joins.
natural_job_window_baseline: Recorded post-scheduled-sync snapshot at job 430: 526 current Masters, 3138 source rows, 16352 observations, 740 reviews, 498 open. Current: 526, 3138, 16460, 742, 498.
